Gifted: Vibration.name: Gifted: Vibration
Gifted: Vibration.description:
🧬 Vibration, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Your palm strike rattles a person off their feet, and a palm on the floor reveals footsteps and hollow spaces a room or two away.
📈 Training adds numbing a grip, shaking concrete to rubble, climbing sheer walls, packing rubble over trapped people, quakes through armor and holding a building still.
⚠️ It works only through touch: nothing crosses open air, and mud, water or thick padding swallows it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Recoil, as every quake you release also shakes your own wrists and elbows.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Yo Shindo (Vibrate).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Vibration.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Vibration family): Scale: the user vibrates what they touch, faint hum to violent shake, and feels vibration via hands and feet. New adult user: a palm strike knocks an adult down and cracks paving stone or cinderblock; a palm on floor or wall feels footsteps, drops and hollows through about two rooms or one floor. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: contact only, via solid joined material, never air; soft soil, mud, water, loose sand and padding absorb it. No sensing the perfectly still, fliers or swimmers; engines and machinery drown it. Shaking a load-bearing wall apart can drop a floor. Quirk Strain: light: strike, reading; moderate: numbing grip, shattered wall, climb; heavy: packing rubble, quake through armor; severe: signature move, holding a building still. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed wall or pavement shattering: property damage; a quake cracking a structure near bystanders: reckless endangerment.
